chapter: Band family, war years and wrap-up
title: Deaths of his father, mother and grandfather
summary: His father had a stroke, his mother died in 1968, and he performed on learning of his grandfather's death.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You father died when you were 7 years old?
I think I was 7.
Somewhere around there.
Yeah. I remember that being there.
That was one of the past releases, you know.
But, he had a stroke.
He had a stroke.
Right.
And, your mother passed?
It was '68, I believe.
'68, right. I was here and I had to go back.
Right.

She was sick and then my other family, I guess they didn't want to bother me. They didn't want to let me know about it. They knew how I felt, how close we was cause when I was there before, I remember my mother telling me because we have, it's a very large place there, the home, in the middle of a lot of ground. And, cause all my other brothers had passed already. She said I know you're not coming back here to live. But,
I want you to be sure you take care of your sister. Now, I did get to question her. I didn't know how she felt all that time.

So, it wasn't too long after that, I got back here maybe 2 or 3 months. I called, I just happened to call. I just wanted to call and see how everybody was. Then, my aunt, my cousin answered the phone. She said Erskine. I said I want to speak to mother. She said "Well, how about calling tomorrow. I'm trying to get her straightened out." Now, I didn't know she was that sick.

So, I called the next day. Only this time, my sister answered. She said my mother passed last night or something like that. And that was a shock. They tried to keep all this from me, you know, cause they didn't want to shock me on my job.
Yeah.
The same thing hit me when I was in the Apollo Theater, my grandfather. They sent me a wire. I was going on stage. He was my father after my father passed.
Yeah.
So, what happened?
I was out there. Tears was coming down, but nobody noticed. They thought I was perspiring. So, I did the show. So, I went through with it like nothing happened.
Well, that was some of the sad parts of my life during that time, you know.
Well, those things happen to all of us some days.
